correctness.rationale: For three-block upper nilpotent algebra A(X,Y,Z), AB has central block XV and BA has block UY. For ranks a=rank X,b=rank Y, simultaneous annihilation imposes independent linear conditions at+rb; circle commutation imposes XV=UY whose image-space intersection has dimension ab. Thus |Cb(A)|=q^{rs+st+rt-at-rb} and |CG(A)|=q^{rs+st+rt-at-rb+ab}; gap q^{ab}. Averaging over rectangular matrix rank strata gives brace and group commuting probabilities. A commutator central block factors as [X,-U][V;Y] through dimension 2s; conditioning on first-factor image gives F_k(2s) exact fiber q^{2rt}F. Rank subadditivity and decomposition into rank-one factors yield exact commutator width ceil(rank C/(2s)) and additive-product width ceil(rank C/s), including zero. For s->infty and fixed r,t,q full ranks dominate, giving q^{-rt} versus q^{-2rt} limits. Independent F2 r=2,s=1,t=2 enumeration counts brace-centralizing pairs 49, group-commuting pairs 58 and commutator fibers by rank (58 for rank0, 18 each for nine rank1 matrices, 6 each for six rank2 matrices) over noncentral quadruples, agreeing with formulas.
